content.text:
Skipped lint (needed approval); the added code mirrors the existing `hasRoute` style exactly.

## Changes

**`lib/route.js:180-185`** — `findRoute()` now normalizes the method before the router lookup, matching `hasRoute()` at line 172:

```js
function findRoute (options) {
  const normalizedMethod = options.method?.toUpperCase() ?? ''
  const route = router.find(
    normalizedMethod,
    options.url || '',
    options.constraints
  )
```

**`test/find-route.test.js`** — added `findRoute should normalize the method`, which registers a `GET` route and looks it up with `method: 'get'`, asserting the resolved `params.artistId`. (Used `strictEqual` on the field rather than `deepStrictEqual` on `params`, since the router returns a null-prototype object.)

**Co-change partner:** COMPLEX.md pairs `lib/route.js` with `fastify.js` (40 commits together). I opened `fastify.js` — its `findRoute` at line 215 is a bare delegation to `router.findRoute(options)` with no method handling of its own, so no change was needed there.

## Verification

`node --test test/find-route.test.js` → 8 pass, 0 fail. I did not run `test/has-route.test.js` or the full suite, per your one-file limit.
